subject: english
question:
The sentence given below has spelling errors. Select the sentence without spelling errors.

Though we read and hear a lot on green initiattive, we hardly tweak our routines to suite the larger picture.

options.text: Though we read and hear a lot on green initiatives, we hardly tweak our routines to suit the larger picture.
Throug we read and hear a lot on green initiatives, we hardly tweak our routines to suite the larger picture.
Though we read and hear a lot on green initiatives, we hardly tweek our routines to suite the larger picture.
Though we read and hear a lot on green iniciatives, we hardly tweak our routines to suite the larger picture.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Though we read and hear a lot on green initiatives, we hardly tweak our routines to suit the larger picture**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• All the **spellings **of the words in option 1 are correct.
 
• Let's look at the meanings of some of the words:
 
• The word **"Initiative"** means the ability to assess and initiate things independently. (प्रवर्तन)
 
 
• **Example: **She took the initiative to start a recycling program in her community.
 
 
 
• **"Suit" **refers to being appropriate or fitting for a particular purpose, person, or occasion. (अनुकूल होना)
 
 
• **Example: **This dress suits her perfectly for the evening gala.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** "Throug" is a misspelling of "Though". (हालांकि)

 
 
• **Example:** Throug we read and hear a lot on green initiatives, we hardly tweak our routines to suite the larger picture.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Tweek" is a misspelling of "Tweak". (थोड़ा बदलना)
 
 
• **Example: **Though we read and hear a lot on green initiatives, we hardly tweek our routines to suite the larger picture.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "Iniciatives" is a misspelling of "Initiatives". (प्रवर्तन)
 
 
• **Example:** Though we read and hear a lot on green iniciatives, we hardly tweak our routines to suite the larger picture.
